PullRequest.Title: skills: remove find-issue and find-duplicates wrappers
PullRequest.Body:
Removes the `find-issue` and `find-duplicates` skills from this repo.

They were two-line wrappers that fetched their instructions by URL from microsoft/vscode-engineering. The full skills stay in that repo as `/find-issue` and `/find-duplicates-interactive`, so run them from a vscode-engineering workspace. Removing the wrappers means changes to those skills no longer need matching PRs here.

**Merge order:** merge before or together with microsoft/vscode-engineering#3932. That PR deletes the files these wrappers fetch.

Scenarios.Scenario: Workspace skill discovery and completion for the repository's .github/skills directory
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The host enumerates and reads available SKILL.md metadata before presenting or resolving repository skills; no changed application runtime, rendering, startup, IPC, subprocess, database, or network path is added by these deletions.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Enumerate repository skills and read SKILL.md metadata
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two fewer tiny file reads on a cold scan; zero reads for these paths after the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Both wrapper files were present and eligible for the same existing discovery scan.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: If repository skill discovery is on the host's completion/listing path, the deletion slightly reduces rather than increases its filesystem work.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of repository skill files. The diff lowers effective cardinality by exactly two small files; it does not add per-item work or increase scan frequency.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No concurrency mechanism is changed. Any existing directory enumeration behavior remains unchanged and processes two fewer entries.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold discovery has two fewer files to inspect; warm discovery/cache behavior is unchanged except those two keys no longer exist. No cache invalidation, miss retry, coalescing, or negative-cache behavior is introduced by the diff.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the diff exclusively deletes two nine-line SKILL.md files and changes no discovery implementation or call frequency.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The host's exact caching and enumeration implementation is external to these deleted instruction files, but that uncertainty cannot turn a two-file deletion into added work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The changed scenario performs less filesystem and metadata work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Invoking the repository-local find-issue or find-duplicates wrapper
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Before the diff, an explicit invocation instructed the agent to fetch one prompt from GitHub before performing issue searches. After the diff, these repository-local wrappers are absent, so this repository introduces no replacement fetch, search loop, serialization, IPC, or subprocess work on that path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch the referenced prompt file from github.com on explicit skill invocation
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Previously one prompt-file request per explicit invocation, subject to external client caching; now zero from these repository-local wrappers.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Each wrapper explicitly directed one prompt-file fetch before following the fetched instructions.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The request previously preceded the issue-search workflow. The diff removes that boundary from this repository and does not move it onto another local path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One remote prompt fetch per explicit wrapper invocation before the diff; zero wrapper-triggered fetches after it. Subsequent issue-search cardinality was governed by external prompt instructions that the diff removes rather than modifies.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: No batching, limiter, queue, or concurrency behavior is added or changed; the two independent invocation entry points are deleted.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The deleted wrappers did not define a cache. Any HTTP or agent-level cache was external; after deletion there is no repository-local request to cache, coalesce, retry, or negatively cache.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: both deleted files directly contained the only repository references to these wrapper names and their prompt-fetch instructions; repository searches found no replacement references.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Users may run equivalent skills from vscode-engineering, but that is outside this repository diff and no local fallback or forwarding path is added here.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The diff removes the local network-triggering entry points; any loss of availability is correctness/product scope, not a performance issue.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed the complete two-file inventory and both full diff pages. The PR only deletes two small repository skill wrappers. It adds no hot-path work, retained state, cache lifecycle, concurrency burst, serialization, or expensive boundary; the only filesystem and network work affected is removed. No findings or regression-fix record are warranted.
